purpose: Rank the maximum comparable set of current, varied and new agents on completed 4h Bitget full8 bars, attributing trades to market regimes without an external NoTrade gate.
action_normalization: Legacy spot LONG actions 1/2/3 and simple-research targets are evaluated as equivalent linear Bitget futures positions under one disclosed cost model; source lane remains in trade evidence.

agents.hypothesis: ATR-scaled channel breakouts adapt the entry distance to 4h volatility.
Prior-range expansion from the current open captures directional impulse.
Re-entry from an RSI extreme is more robust than trading the extreme itself.
Price and signed-volume divergence identifies exhausted directional moves.
Kaufman-style path efficiency separates persistent trends from noisy moves.
Momentum in high volatility and reversion in low volatility share one causal policy.
Volume-weighted fair-value deviations revert on liquid 4h bars.
Large directional bodies closing near an extreme with volume confirm continuation.
Market-demeaned full8 momentum retains relative continuation information.
Extreme short-horizon full8 relative moves partially reverse.

excluded_components.reason: requires point-in-time funding, OI, crowding and basis; absent from the common OHLCV contract
requires an external timestamped signal file and is not an autonomous market strategy
requires point-in-time funding rates and sub-bar funding-cutoff timing
trained checkpoints have a fixed feature cadence and missing runtime dependency crypto_exchange
exit-only overlay requires externally synchronized positions and cannot be scored standalone
source dependencies crypto_agents.py and crypto_players.py are absent; current factory builds empty or invalid sub-agent pools
they require the separate Freqtrade portfolio/ROI/stoploss execution contract and cannot be mixed into the component ledger without changing semantics
their multi-leg or derivatives-context contract is not representable by a single-symbol OHLCV timebase audit
No continuous point-in-time L2 snapshots exist for the common 2022-2026 full8 window; using OHLCV proxies would mislabel the experiment.
